name: Movies Remastered (MRDb)
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: Fetches fan edit metadata from the Movies Remastered Database (moviesremastered.com / MRDb), a community fanedit archive. No account required. Please use responsibly — a minimum 1-second delay between requests is enforced.
fixMatchHint: Enter a moviesremastered.com URL (e.g. https://www.moviesremastered.com/movieinfo.php?id=12179) or a bare MRDb numeric ID

background_tasks.description: Builds the local title index that automatic matching (Fetch Missing Metadata) searches against, from moviesremastered.com's own sitemap.xml plus each fan edit's page — this is how automatic discovery works without ever calling the site's disallowed search endpoint. A first run crawls the whole site (~3,300 pages at a minimum 1-second delay each, roughly an hour); later runs only fetch pages added since the last sync, which is normally quick. Run this at least once before relying on Fetch Missing Metadata for this plugin; without it, automatic matching finds nothing.

run_confirmation.title: Sync MRDb search index?
run_confirmation.message: A first-time sync crawls every fan edit on Movies Remastered (~3,300 pages) with a minimum 1-second delay between requests — expect roughly an hour. Later syncs only fetch pages added since the last run and are much faster. Please don't run this more than about once a week.

background_tasks.description: Matches unmatched fan edits by title against the local search index (built by the Sync Search Index task) and fetches full MRDb metadata for each match. Finds nothing until Sync Search Index has run at least once. A title can also always be matched manually via Fix Match with a moviesremastered.com URL.

run_confirmation.title: Fetch MRDb metadata?
run_confirmation.message: Movies Remastered is a small community site. This task makes one HTTP request per fan edit with a minimum 1-second delay between each — on a large library this will take a long time. Please run this sparingly, not more than a few times per week.

background_tasks.description: Re-fetches MRDb metadata for all fan edits to pick up updated descriptions, ratings, and images.

run_confirmation.title: Re-sync all MRDb metadata?
run_confirmation.message: This will re-fetch MRDb metadata for every fan edit in your library. Movies Remastered is a small community site — each request has a minimum 1-second delay. On a large library this will take a very long time. Please use this sparingly.
